name: L298N motor driver
description: Dual H-bridge for two DC motors. IN1/IN2 set motor A's direction (IN3/IN4 for B); PWM on ENA/ENB sets speed (leave ENA/ENB unconnected = jumper on = full speed). Power it from 12V/GND; outputs lose ~1.4 V like the real chip. The 5V pin outputs 5 V when 12V ≥ 7 V.
